summary: The compliance review of SakhiCredit's digital loan product for women's self-help groups identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. Key findings include: (1) The app's location access feature lacks documentation on need-based data collection, explicit consent, audit trails, and restrictions on mobile phone resource access. (2) The app does not provide borrowers with options to manage data consent, restrict disclosure, or revoke consent. (3) Borrowers are not informed of their right to escalate rejected complaints to the RBI Ombudsman. (4) The product lacks a privacy policy on its website, with plans to publish one next year. These issues require immediate attention to ensure compliance with RBI regulations.
